verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents several in-product AI features that turn incident data into insights and suggestions. These include AI incident summaries generated at declaration and tailored by audience, "Draft with AI" retrospectives that analyze the timeline and propose lessons learned, AI-captured Zoom chat insights, and a Copilot that compares ongoing incidents to past ones and makes suggestions in Command Center and Slack. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI features' quality and usefulness.
